limitations: Variants used different physical GPU/VM identities, without hardware crossover.
Short hello workload at C1/C8; client/network resources were not dedicated. No maximum server capacity or broader workload claim.
Only within-profile A/B percentages are eligible. Transports and client details differ across experiments.

The portable client follows the workload/timing contract but is not the literal orchestration harness. SSL-context and connection-cleanup differences are disclosed. All saved responses were rechecked with its validator.
The small word/arithmetic suite retains shared baseline errors and does not certify general model quality.
The model/tokenizer revision and AMD64 image were pinned. The FP8 numerical precision change is explicit.
